entries.title: Dracodia helicopter / digital jungle and modular aimed pods
entries.note: Fresh real native Furious helicopter checkpoint: full3690HP, other lives cleared before recording; invulnerable input-only observer reacts to the committed gun lanes and red pressure fronts. No recorder HP, phase or clock writes during footage. 15% smaller source-locked body, four-times rotor playback, independently turning/recoiling destructible missile pods with actual player Retina locks, rapid finite volleys, and two authored digital-jungle parallax layers. Native copied-life defeat and opening final destruction retained. Gun escape separately passes without GOD on Normal/Hard/Furious. Original Stage1 helicopter remains unchanged.
